title: GTA 6 Physical Edition: No Disc in the Box? What You're Actually Buying
desc: The GTA 6 'physical' copies on Amazon are a code in a box with no disc. Here's what that means for the 212 GB download, resale and gifting.
lede: If you're buying GTA 6 in a box, check the listing: Amazon's PS5 and Xbox listings say "Code in Box" and "No physical disc in box". Here's what that changes.
sections: A download code, not a game disc. Amazon's GTA 6 listings for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S are both labeled "Code in Box", and the PS5 listing adds "No physical disc in box".
Because there's no disc, the full install (up to 212 GB, per Rockstar) comes over the internet either way. Make room first.
No disc means a PS5 Digital Edition or Xbox Series S can use the boxed version too, since you just redeem the code.
Once a code is redeemed, it's tied to that account, so you can't resell or lend it like a disc. As a gift, it still works: the box arrives, they redeem the code.
Amazon's PS5 listing says the code only works on PlayStation accounts registered in the US or Canada. Check before gifting abroad.
faq: Does the GTA 6 physical copy have a disc?
Amazon's listings say no: it's a code in a box, and the game downloads to your console.
Does the boxed GTA 6 work on PS5 Digital Edition?
Yes. It's a download code, so no disc drive is needed.
